body:
This fits the definition of a note, I think.
```suggestion
			[b]Note:[/b] Unlike tags in [member text], [member bbcode_prefix] is not included as part of the string extracted by the PO translation extractor. This can be used to ensure tags are not part of localizable strings if they are always located at the beginning/end of [member text].
```
Although, hmm...
```suggestion
			[b]Note:[/b] Unlike tags in [member text], [member bbcode_prefix] is not included as part of the string extracted by the PO translation extractor. This ensures that the tags contained in this property are not part of the localizable strings.
```
If you notice, with a bit of restructuring, the first sentence sounds a lot like the second. It's a bit redundant. I'm not sure how to proceed...?
```suggestion
			[b]Note:[/b] Unlike tags in [member text], [member bbcode_prefix] is not included as part of the string extracted by the PO translation extractor, meaning they cannot be localized.
```

Also, mentioning a "PO translation extractor" with no sources or references feels wrong. For most users this is meaningless information.
What's the purpose of adding closing tags if the prefix is supposed to affect the whole text?
You could add a `bbcode` group and use `PROPERTY_HINT_GROUP_ENABLE` to `bbcode_enabled`.
